d:
The Spurs defeated the Mavericks, 112-111 tonight in San Antonio. Victor Wembanyama contributed a team-high 52 points to go with 8 blocks 24 rebounds and 2 steals, with Dylan Harper of the Spurs adding an additional 21 points (9-15 FG, 1-2 3P) in the game. Kyrie Irving finished with a team-high 29 points along with 7 rebounds for the Mavericks in the losing effort. The Spurs improve their record to 6-2 with the win, while the Mavericks fall to 4-4 for the season.
